missions.title: Maid Service
missions.description: Emma's house came with staff. Yuka, the maid, spends her afternoons in the laundry room, and not only washing.

intro.speaker: The Collector
intro.text: Emma has a maid. Quiet girl, Yuka. Nobody watches the laundry room in the afternoon.

intro.speaker: The Collector
intro.text: Somebody should. Get me a picture of her down there.

objectives.text: Photograph Yuka in the laundry room

bonus.text: Hide a camera in the laundry room

missions.title: House Rules
missions.description: Camila's housemate Jamal and the locked room upstairs: every afternoon the two of them disappear in there.

intro.speaker: The Collector
intro.text: Camila doesn't live alone. Big guy, Jamal. Afternoons, the red room door stays shut.

intro.speaker: The Collector
intro.text: I want Jamal on camera in that room. You'll see why.

objectives.text: Photograph Jamal in the red room

bonus.text: Get Camila in the shot too
Hide a camera in the red room

outro.speaker: The Collector
outro.text: House rules. I like their house.

missions.title: Late Shift
missions.description: Peter works all day and comes to bed at midnight. Emma waits up for him.

intro.speaker: The Collector
intro.text: Emma's husband, Peter. Desk all day, then midnight with his wife.

intro.speaker: The Collector
intro.text: Their bedroom, after midnight. Photo of Peter. Don't get caught, he's not the forgiving type.

objectives.text: Photograph Peter in the master bedroom

outro.speaker: The Collector
outro.text: Overtime pays. For both of us.
